title: DIR-067: Fix Recruiter HTML Download to Real PDF/DOCX, 10/10 Adaptive Partitioner Orphan Prevention, and Recruiter Drawer Layout Polish
spec: P0 ARCHITECTURAL MANDATES: 1. RECRUITER PORTAL DOWNLOAD REPAIR: In src/components/EmployerPortal/EmployerApplicantPipeline.jsx, replace the hand-rolled .html blob download with centralized downloadResumePdf and downloadResumeDocx from src/utils/exportDownloader.js. Provide direct PDF and Word (DOCX) export buttons in the recruiter candidate preview drawer matching JobApplicationsModal.jsx, eliminating raw .html file downloads. 2. 10/10 ADAPTIVE PARTITIONER ORPHAN PREVENTION: In src/engine/hybrid/smartPartitioner.js, eliminate the awkward 1-card Page 2 orphan defect (where 4 certifications stay on Page 1 and only 1 card spills onto Page 2 with 85% blank space). Implement: (A) Adaptive Micro-Compaction: When overflow onto Page 2 is minor (<=60px / single trailing row), dynamically test compact section gap rhythm (11px instead of 14px) to fit the entire resume onto 1 balanced page with zero footer overlap. (B) Section Integrity & Orphan Guard: When 2 pages are genuinely required, a continuation section must never strand a single isolated card on Page 2. Rebalance sections (e.g. moving the full Certifications block to Page 2) so Page 2 presents a complete, intentional section. 3. RECRUITER DRAWER UI POLISH: In EmployerApplicantPipeline.jsx, decouple the Cover Letter from the bottom edge of the A4 canvas, presenting it in a distinct card container or clean tabbed view. 4. ENVIRONMENT & ZERO-REGRESSION GUARDS: 100% Linux server compatible, zero OS console windows, no winget/cmd/PowerShell. Frozen src/cv-templates/ remains git diff 0. Run full test suites, capture Playwright evidence, and submit for Gatekeeper certification.

plan.summary: DIR-067 P0, root causes confirmed by reading source. CONTRACTS/INVARIANTS: the frozen src/cv-templates tree stays git diff 0, the preview gate and the DIR-064/065/066 suites must stay green, and no detached/background server or Windows-only tooling may be introduced (XAMPP-only, xampp-policy guard). (1) RECRUITER DOWNLOAD REPAIR: EmployerApplicantPipeline.jsx handleDownload currently builds a raw .html file (new Blob([buildPrintableDocument(...)]) + URL.createObjectURL + a[download]='-resume.html'), which is a dead-end artefact, not a resume export. The print path (iframe + contentWindow.print via buildPrintableDocument) is correct and stays. The HTML download is replaced by the centralized downloadResumePdf/downloadResumeDocx from src/utils/exportDownloader.js, matching JobApplicationsModal.jsx. KEY GAP: the backend has /api/public-export for PDF (published-only, no owner session) but the only DOCX route /api/export-docx is owner-scoped via req.user.uid, so a recruiter can never export a candidate's Word file. I will add POST /api/public-export-docx that mirrors the public PDF authorization EXACTLY (repo.getPublicResume, isPublished===true, publicationMode==='explicit', the owner's isMembershipActive entitlement gate, watermark for non-paid owners) and reuses createResumeDocx + resolveExportTemplate, with EXPORTABLE_TEMPLATE validation and the existing exportAccountLimiter, so the public DOCX path is published-only and cannot be used for IDOR. (2) ADAPTIVE PARTITIONER ORPHAN PREVENTION: the greedy packer strands a single trailing certification row on Page 2 (4 cards on Page 1, 1 card on Page 2 with 85% blank). I will extract the packer into a reusable packSections(sectionGapPx) and add (A) Adaptive Micro-Compaction, re-packing with an 11px section rhythm when the Page 2 overflow is minor (<=60px or a single trailing row) and adopting it only if the whole resume then fits one page with zero footer overlap, and (B) a Section Integrity and Orphan Guard that, when two pages are genuinely required, moves the WHOLE continuation section onto the last page instead of stranding one isolated card, falling back to the original packing if the moved section would overflow. The returned sectionGapPx is applied by SmartResumeComposer.jsx as an inline --smart-section-gap on the page root so the rendered rhythm matches the estimate exactly and no footer overlap can be introduced. (3) DRAWER UI POLISH: the cover letter is a footer glued to the bottom edge of the A4 canvas; it becomes a clean tabbed view (Resume / Cover letter) with role=tablist, aria-selected, aria-controls and keyboard arrow/Home/End navigation, with the sanitized cover letter in its own card container. UX STATES: each export button carries its own loading state and a themed error banner, the preview keeps its existing loading skeleton and no-resume empty state, and a failed export never fabricates a file. ACCESSIBILITY: the new tabs are keyboard operable with visible focus rings and correct aria wiring, contrast of the tab and button tokens stays >=4.5:1, and the drawer keeps a single labelled dialog. SECURITY: the public DOCX route is published-only, is rate-limited, never trusts client colors or template identity, validates resumeId and resumeName, and no Bearer token or secret is logged. PERFORMANCE: the packer re-run is at most two extra O(n) passes over the already-computed sections (no DOM work, no extra re-renders), the render budget stays sub-100ms and the build budget stays sub-4.0s. QA: a new dir067 static+functional suite, the updated dir066/dir048/dir056 contracts, the DIR-064/065/066 suites, the template-lab DOM census and overflow probes, and a headless Playwright verification of the recruiter drawer. No native OS console windows and no winget/cmd/PowerShell. All servers stay on XAMPP.
steps: 1. EmployerApplicantPipeline.jsx: remove the hand-rolled .html download (Blob + URL.createObjectURL + a[download]) entirely and import downloadResumePdf and downloadResumeDocx from utils/exportDownloader, adding handleDownloadPdf and handleDownloadDocx that pass endpoint /api/public-export and /api/public-export-docx respectively with withAuth false and the loaded resumeId, resumeName, language, firstname and lastname

2. EmployerApplicantPipeline.jsx: replace the single Download toolbar button with distinct PDF and Word (DOCX) buttons matching JobApplicationsModal.jsx, each disabled until the resume values load, each with an aria-label and an in-flight loading label, plus a role=status error line so a failure is surfaced instead of silently swallowed

3. backend/index.js: add POST /api/public-export-docx that mirrors the public PDF authorization exactly (repo.getPublicResume, isPublished true, publicationMode explicit, the owner isMembershipActive entitlement gate and the non-paid watermark), reuses createResumeDocx and resolveExportTemplate, validates resumeId and resumeName against EXPORTABLE_TEMPLATE, and sits behind exportAccountLimiter so it is published-only and IDOR-safe

4. EmployerApplicantPipeline.jsx: decouple the cover letter from the A4 canvas bottom edge by rendering a tabbed view (Resume and Cover letter) with role=tablist, role=tab, aria-selected, aria-controls, keyboard arrow plus Home and End navigation and visible focus rings, showing the sanitized cover letter inside its own card container

5. smartPartitioner.js: extract the greedy packer into a reusable packSections(sectionGapPx) helper that returns the page buckets, so the same deterministic packing can be re-run with a different rhythm without touching the render path

6. smartPartitioner.js: implement Adaptive Micro-Compaction, re-packing with an 11px section rhythm when the two-page result has a minor Page 2 overflow (<=60px of content or a single trailing row), adopting it only when the entire resume then fits one page with zero footer overlap

7. smartPartitioner.js: implement the Section Integrity and Orphan Guard, which detects a continuation section stranded as a single isolated card or row on the last page and moves the whole section onto that page so it reads as a complete intentional section, falling back to the original packing when the moved section would overflow

8. SmartResumeComposer.jsx: apply the partitioner sectionGapPx as an inline --smart-section-gap on the page root so the rendered rhythm matches the estimate exactly (unchanged from the density default unless micro-compaction fired)

9. tests: author tests/dir067-...test.mjs with static and functional contracts (no .html blob download remains, both PDF and DOCX buttons are wired to the centralized client, the public DOCX route is published-only, the tabbed cover letter exposes aria tab semantics, a 5-certification profile no longer strands a one-row Page 2 widow, and a minor-overflow profile micro-compacts onto a single page) and update tests/dir066 S4 plus any dir048, dir056 or full-control-surface assertions that pinned the removed HTML download or the glued cover-letter footer

10. evidence: run npm run lint, npm run test:security:static, npm run test:xampp-policy, the new dir067 suite, the DIR-064/065/066 and template suites, the template-lab DOM census and overflow probes, and npm run build (verify sub-4.0s), confirm src/cv-templates git diff is 0, then submit the logs via bridge dev submit-evidence for Gatekeeper certification.

evidence.summary: DIR-067 COMPLETE. (1) RECRUITER DOWNLOAD REPAIR: EmployerApplicantPipeline.jsx no longer builds a dead-end .html blob (the Blob + URL.createObjectURL + a[download]='-resume.html' path is deleted). The drawer now has distinct PDF and Word (DOCX) buttons that call downloadResumePdf / downloadResumeDocx from src/utils/exportDownloader.js with endpoint /api/public-export and /api/public-export-docx, withAuth false, per-button loading labels, an aria-label each, and a role=alert error banner. KEY GAP FOUND AND CLOSED: the only DOCX route was OWNER-scoped (/api/export-docx via req.user.uid), so a recruiter could never export a candidate's Word file. I added POST /api/public-export-docx to backend/index.js that mirrors the public PDF authorization EXACTLY - repo.getPublicResume, isPublished===true, publicationMode==='explicit', the owner isMembershipActive entitlement gate - reusing resolveExportTemplate + createResumeDocx, validating resumeId and EXPORTABLE_TEMPLATE, trusting NO owner session (no req.user.uid), and sitting behind exportAccountLimiter plus the public-path CSRF allowlist, so it is published-only and IDOR-safe. (2) ADAPTIVE PARTITIONER ORPHAN PREVENTION: extracted the greedy packer into a reusable packSections(sectionGapPx). (A) Adaptive Micro-Compaction re-packs with an 11px section rhythm whenever the two-page result has a minor trailing overflow (<=60px or a single trailing row) and adopts it ONLY when the whole resume then fits one page; the chosen rhythm is returned as sectionGapPx and SmartResumeComposer.jsx pins it as an inline --smart-section-gap so the painted gap always equals the estimate (no footer overlap). (B) Section Integrity & Orphan Guard moves a whole continuation section onto the last page when that page would otherwise hold a single isolated card/row of a section that continues from an earlier page, reverting if the receiving page would overflow. FUNCTIONAL PROOF: a 2 x 7 x 9 x 11 profile sweep (minimal-ats and modern-split) shows micro-compaction firing and collapsing to 1 page, and asserts the invariant that NO page ever strands a single isolated continuation row. (3) RECRUITER DRAWER UI POLISH: the cover letter is no longer a footer glued to the bottom edge of the A4 canvas; it is now a clean tabbed view (Resume / Cover letter) with role=tablist, role=tab, aria-selected, aria-controls, tabIndex roving, ArrowLeft/ArrowRight/Home/End keyboard navigation and visible focus rings, rendering the sanitized cover letter inside its own rounded card container in a separate scroll panel. (4) GUARDS: 100% Linux compatible, zero OS console windows, no winget/cmd/PowerShell, no detached server; src/cv-templates git diff = 0; xampp-policy 4/4. SUPERSEDED CONTRACTS UPDATED: tests/dir066 S4 and tests/dir056 SUB-056-5 previously pinned the removed .html download (buildPrintableDocument x2); they now assert the print path keeps the styled builder and the download is a real PDF/DOCX. EVIDENCE: new tests/dir067-recruiter-export-partitioner-orphan.test.mjs 7/7 (recruiter uses the centralized client with the public endpoints and no URL.createObjectURL; distinct PDF/Word buttons with loading+error states; tabbed cover letter with full aria semantics and the glued footer gone; the public DOCX route is published-only and rate-limited; packSections/COMPACT_SECTION_GAP_PX 11/MINOR_OVERFLOW_PX 60/applyOrphanGuard present; plus the two functional sweeps). Regression: dir064/065/066/067/063 + previews + empty-sections + dir048/055/056 + employer portal 125/125; backend DOCX + parity + export pipeline 38/38; full control surface 2052/2052; product slice 104/104. HEADLESS PLAYWRIGHT EVIDENCE: DOM census over all 55 templates on the gridDense fixture -> CENSUS PASS, no grid card overlaps the page footer (0px on every CV); overflow probe on long (55 templates) -> 0 clipped elements, 0 probe failures. GATES: lint 0 errors (253 pre-existing warnings); security:static 67/67; xampp-policy 4/4; build 'built in 3.14s' (under the 4.0s budget). HONEST LIMITS: the recruiter DOCX export requires the candidate to have PUBLISHED their resume (the same published-only rule as the existing public PDF path), and returns an honest error otherwise - it cannot export an unpublished draft. The DOCX builder has no watermark support, so the public DOCX route gates on the owner entitlement exactly like the existing /api/export-docx rather than stamping a free-plan watermark the way the PDF path does. Mechanism (B) is a safety net: across the swept profile space the row-paired packer already avoids continuation widows, so the guard did not need to fire, but the invariant it guarantees is asserted on every swept profile.
